description: This file contains utility functions and a main exported function to generate an executive summary report based on a dashboard snapshot object. It includes functions for formatting numbers, text, determining net position, extracting top categories and largest spends, and assembling a list of up to 6 business-focused bullet points.

methods.name: generateExecutiveSummary
methods.description: Generates a concise, business-friendly summary report (up to 6 bullet points) based on a snapshot object from the dashboard. Focuses on cash position, spending concentration, flagged activity, largest spend, data coverage, and opportunities.
